about: BABEL's arcs for the director (dungeon/director.py), from dungeon/world/packages/babel/beats.json and hidden-truths.json. Each stage has its tier, what is true (truth), a seed the narrator may plant, and how it reaches a character who is not there (word). The Season on the Reachwall and the First Frost run as planned beats in the package; this file carries the arcs that run from arrival day. Drafts for Vanta to keep, change or cut.

arcs.name: The climb
arcs.seen: Four people from one engagement party came down on two different floors, and the only way anyone talks about home is up.

antagonist.name: the tower
antagonist.agenda: to keep the four apart and climbing, and to see what each of them will pay to leave a floor

stages.truth: Bri and Chase came down on the Gilded Bazaar, three floors up, and the Roll lists them with the Bazaar's mark.
stages.seed: A line on the Waystone's Roll: two names from Earth, a floor number, and a coin-shaped glyph.
stages.word: A porter from the Bazaar says two new-wave climbers from the same party as the engineer are up there, and broke.

stages.truth: The way up from the Concourse runs through Varrow, and Varrow's Close weighs every big arrival who passes.
stages.seed: Cobb at the cage looks at the character's size and says nothing, which is worse.
stages.word: Word on the Concourse: the Close weighed another one at the ford.

stages.truth: The Stair is out above the fourth floor. The way up from there goes through the floors themselves, and every floor costs something to leave.
stages.seed: A broken span on a copied map, and an arrow drawn into the Foundry.
stages.word: A climber who went up says the Stair just stops above the Foundry.

stages.truth: Nobody who has reached the top has come back down to say what is there.
stages.seed: An old climber's chalk mark, very high up a landing wall: a ring, and nothing inside it.
stages.word: A rumor from the high floors: someone made the top, and the Roll stopped listing them.

arcs.name: The Wakeful's eyes
arcs.seen: Old natives look twice at white-ringed eyes, and none of them will say who wore them last.

antagonist.name: Darla Kinney
antagonist.agenda: to keep what happened to Teague above Varrow buried, until the new white ring makes that impossible

stages.truth: Teague, a big climber with white-ringed eyes, came down three years ago, stood a season on the Reachwall, and went up the Margrave's cellar stair with Darla. Only she came back.
stages.seed: Ruth Ann at the forge holds a hammer handle that was cut for a much bigger hand, and asks where the character got their eyes.
stages.word: Someone on the Concourse asked Hamid about the white ring, and Hamid shut his cart early.

stages.truth: The Reach giants remember Teague as a Wakeful who promised them the stair, and they take the new white ring for him.
stages.seed: A giant at the ditch calls out a word in a tongue nobody on the Wall speaks, and looks straight at the character.
stages.word: The Wall says a giant came to the ditch calling for its brother.

stages.truth: Teague is still on the Roll, marked no longer climbing. Darla knows what that means and has never said.
stages.seed: The Muster board at the Keep has a name scratched out and written back in, twice.
stages.word: Darla Kinney has left the Landing and gone up to Varrow.

arcs.name: The Bazaar's price
arcs.seen: The Gilded Bazaar takes everything in trade, and two new climbers there have already learned what that means.

antagonist.name: Sabeen Oro
antagonist.agenda: to own the engineer who wrote the new rules before anyone else does, starting with the debts of the two who love him

stages.truth: Sabeen Oro of the Lantern Room learned what the engineer is worth from the two who came down on her floor, and gave them a chit that is really a contract.
stages.seed: A Lantern Room chit, gilt-edged, with a clause in small hand that keeps going after the line.
stages.word: A trader from the Bazaar says the Lantern Room is asking after an engineer from the new wave.

stages.truth: Sabeen's runner has gone down the Stair to fetch the engineer, and is hired into the Keep as a harper.
stages.seed: A new harper at the Keep who plays well and asks too many questions about the big climber.
stages.word: There is a new harper in Hollin, from up the Stair.

stages.truth: The gate behind the Copper Steps closed on the two defaulters; a night cage took what they had, and a bounty went down the chain ahead of them.
stages.seed: A bounty notice on a Marches landing with two Earth names on it.
stages.word: A bounty board came down from the Bazaar with names from the new wave on it.
